notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered (Shopify store, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, checked first). Category tree taken from the site's own JS mega-menu (data-main-menu-settings JSON attribute on the header, decoded from HTML-entity-escaped JSON embedded in home.html) rather than the full /collections.json list (310 collections total), because most of the 310 are colour/finish/size/style facet re-cuts and seasonal/marketing collections not presented as real nav categories. qty VERIFICATION: Shopify /collections.json products_count proved INFLATED here too (consistent with project memory) - e.g. table-lamps reported 713 vs 332 actual, mirrors reported 129 vs 64 actual, lampshades reported 3656 vs 1731 actual, candle-holders reported 47 vs 8 actual. Collection pages render their product grid entirely client-side (no product tiles or /products/ links present in raw HTML; store uses an Algolia web pixel and no server-rendered count/pagination text), so every qty below was instead verified by exhaustively paginating https://www.pooky.com/collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and de-duplicating unique numeric product IDs until a page returned fewer than 250 items (confirms true end of listing) - this is the 'enumerate to exhaustion and count unique product IDs' cheap proof from Rule 1. evidence field on each row cites the paged products.json URL and page count. RULE 0 GAINS: included the full 'Lighting by Room' branch (Bathroom, Kitchen, Bedroom, Hallway, Living Room, Dining Room, Office lights) despite every node being room-named, plus Bathroom lights and IP-rated (wet-area) lights elsewhere in the nav - none excluded for containing a room word. DEDUP (Rule 0.6): 'Rechargeable lighting' (/collections/rechargeable-lighting) appears both under Lighting>All lighting and under the separate 'Rechargeables' top nav item as 'All rechargeable lighting' - identical URL, listed once only. 'Outdoor lights' (/collections/outdoor-lights) appears both under Lighting>Other popular links and under By room - identical URL, listed once only (under Lighting by Room omitted here, kept in Additional/Popular lighting section - see rows). 'Mirrors' (/collections/mirrors) appears both under Lighting>Other popular links and under Accessories>Bits and bobs - identical URL, listed once only as its own Wall Decor & Mirrors category. Candles collection (10 products: dinner candles, tea lights, pillar candles) verified unscented via body_html (no scent/fragrance/essential-oil text) - kept in scope per Home Fragrance exclusion carve-out. EXCLUDED as out of scope: Sockets & switches and all its sub-branches (by finish: brass/bronze/black/perspex/paintable; by function: toggle/dimmer/plug/coaxial/USB/modules; by collection: Lucian/Florence; by ways: intermediate/two-way) - electrical wiring hardware, not decor. Lightbulbs and candle-lightbulbs/golf-ball/regular bulb collections - excluded (bulbs). Lighting Flex (twisted-lighting-flex) and Spare parts - excluded (wiring/mounting hardware). E-Gift Cards and the two 'Genesis Cell' rechargeable battery accessory products - excluded (not product categories; single replacement parts). 'Rechargeable pendant kits' - excluded, it links to a build-your-own-kit configurator page, not a product listing. Last chance/Sale - excluded (promo). Lampshades sub-nav 'Colour' (9 colour cuts), 'Size' (4 size cuts), 'Style' (gathered/rolled/taped/clip-on) and 'Collections' (Matthew Williamson, Morris & Co., Syrian tiles, Ellen Merchant, GP&J Baker, Collaborative Craft Project, Studio Killian Dawson, Novogratz designer/collaboration lines) - excluded as facet/designer-collection re-cuts of the same Lampshades population (colour and size are unambiguous attribute facets; designer collections are brand/designer listings, both on the NEVER-EXTRACT list). Kept 'Shape' (9 distinct lampshade shapes: straight empire, drum, tall tapered, empire, extreme empire, short drum, fluted fancy, square, scalloped) and 'Material' (7 distinct materials: silk, linen, ikat, block-printed cotton, shibori, card, marbled paper) as genuine sub-type/material categories, consistent with the brief's own INCLUDE list for decorative material lines and mirror-shape precedent (round/rectangular/oval), and because their populations only partially cover the parent 'All lampshades' total rather than exactly summing to it. The other 200+ colour/finish/style/seasonal/loyalty collections visible only in /collections.json (e.g. black-mirrors, brass-pendants, boho, art-deco, mid-century, christmas-lighting-ideas, pooky-faves, archive-collection, valentines-day) were not part of the presented mega-nav taxonomy and were excluded as facet re-cuts or marketing/seasonal collections.
